messages.subject: deshape
parts:
Hello,

I tried installing the reshape package and cannot get the deshape
function to work; tried both Mac osX and linux ubuntu with R 2.8 and
2.9 versions respectively. My goal is use the function auc for each
of the Treatment/Fish combinations --there are 34 combos-- each combo
has 7 time and length attributes.

So, does anyone know why this is happening?

Also, is my code going to achieve my goal; providing that deshape
eventually works?

thanks so much,

JMK

The following is my code:

#ANALYZE FILE

str(NPB);head(NPB,8)

'data.frame': 238 obs. of 4 variables:
$ Treatment: Factor w/ 7 levels "MSeCys","SeCys",..: 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3
3 3 ...
$ Fish : int 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 2 2 2 ...
$ Time : num 0 1.5 3 6 12 24 48 0 1.5 3 ...
$ Se_conc : num 0.0115 0.0436 0.0834 0.1308 0.1906 ...
Treatment Fish Time Se_conc
1 Selenate 1 0.0 0.01145679
2 Selenate 1 1.5 0.04358848
3 Selenate 1 3.0 0.08335803
4 Selenate 1 6.0 0.13076543
5 Selenate 1 12.0 0.19055144
6 Selenate 1 24.0 0.08691358
7 Selenate 1 48.0 0.04503704
8 Selenate 2 0.0 0.01700000

#CREATE
#Output should be the following columns: Treatment, Fish, AUC
observed, AUMC observed, AUC infinity, AUMC infinity
#Load necessary packages

library(sfsmisc);library(PK)


#Check manually

auc(conc=NPB[1:7,4],time=NPB[1:7,3])

#Try reshape package
install.packages("reshape")
library(reshape)

NPB_d <- reshape(NPB,id=1:2) #ERROR: could not find function
"deshape"

reshape(NPB_d, Treatment~ Fish,Time, Se_conc)

messages.subject: Re: deshape
parts:
Hi Josh,

The reshape package uses the melt and cast functions. But it sounds
like the plyr package (http://had.co.nz/plyr) would be a better fit to
your needs.

Hadley
